summary: Current SGLang Req stop matching detected and trimmed <END> after both English and Chinese text with the exact DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 tokenizer. No production change was justified; the PR records an issue-specific executable probe and evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: Real Req.update_finish_state behavior with the exact model tokenizer: English control, reported Chinese prefix, multibyte emoji plus Chinese prefix, and one-token-per-step stop completion all matched and trimmed <END>.
Nine existing scheduler regressions covering multi-token speculative acceptance, stop/EOS precedence, cross-token stops, and independent no-match/regex boundaries.
Eight existing detokenizer regressions covering matched-string and matched-token output trimming boundaries.
Confirmed the assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950; inventory only, not GPU execution.

gpu_execution.evidence: Stop matching and trimming are CPU control flow. The assigned single gfx950 cannot host or reproduce the reported 285B model in a PD-disaggregated H20 deployment; no unrelated GPU smoke was substituted.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model weights were not loaded and model generation was not tested.
The reported H20 PD-disaggregated multi-node/multi-GPU topology was unavailable and remains unverified.
The evidence qualifies the exact tokenizer and current SGLang scheduler/detokenizer stop path, not model semantic accuracy or distributed transport behavior.
